headline: Sciacca Service Center
sub: A no-nonsense diagnosis that you can trust | We offer the lowest rates with the highest quality | Over 25 years of experience so you know you’re in good hands

offerings.title: Honesty | Affordable Pricing | Knowledgeable
offerings.body: Sciacca Service Center has been servicing vehicles in the Norristown, PA area for more than 25 years. First opened in 1989, owner Charlie Interrante named the shop after his hometown in Sciacca, Italy. It is a family-oriented shop with fair prices that you can feel at home with. Take comfort in knowing that you’ll receive an honest opinion rather than an extensive list of repairs to be done. Come visit us and see what a difference an honest, personalized consultation can make!
